risk_items.finding: Reader redirection during market hours could alter regime feature values used by live strategies.
risk_items.evidence: Proposal does not specify a maintenance window or feature freeze.
risk_items.why_it_matters: A timing mismatch between writer cutover and reader redirection can produce inconsistent regime signals.
risk_items.recommended_constraint: Schedule reader redirection outside trading hours or under a feature freeze with explicit validation.
risk_items.required_verification: Regime feature parity check before and after redirection.

blind_spots: Real-time consumers that cache ohlcv aggregates.
questions: Which strategies consume ohlcv-derived regime features?
recommended_task_graph_constraints: Live-trading risk tasks must be human-approved before dispatch.
recommended_verification_gates: Regime feature output parity before/after redirection.
